<thought>Based on the observed isotopic envelope (M+1 ≈11 % of the monoisotopic peak, M+2 ≈1 %, rapidly decreasing thereafter), the pattern matches the natural 13C abundance (≈1.1 % per carbon) for a molecule containing roughly ten carbons. No other characteristic isotope patterns (e.g., Cl, Br, S) are evident. Therefore, carbon is the only element that can be definitively identified from the spectrum.</thought>
<final_answer>['C']</final_answer>
